subject: Aboard the colony ship ariadne, in the bay where the work is being done. The reactor's coolant seals are perishing faster than the manual says they should, and every new one Jeremy fits comes out of the spares that have to last forty years. Michelle has bred a resin from a culture in her lab, and it sets like rubber in an hour. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
